title: Sweet Security Offers All Organizations Affected by HTTP2Shell Virtual Patching Protection at No Cost
content_md: New York, NY, October 27th, 2026, CyberNewswire The root-cause fix will take weeks; protection can’t wait Sweet Security today announced Sweet Safety Net, extending its runtime Virtual Patching protection to every organization affected by HTTP2Shell (CVE-2026-111497).
